changes.description: ACP clients can now sign in from a terminal when `kiro-cli acp` starts logged out
`KIRO_RUNTIME_DIR` sets where Kiro extracts its bundled runtime instead of the home directory
Fullscreen keeps the prompt on the bottom rows, even with a short transcript or after Ctrl+L
The Kiro logo ghost keeps its full color at rest instead of fading after the load animation
On V3, V2-format agents are now upgraded automatically at launch; set `chat.enableAutoAgentUpgrade` to `false` to turn this off
[V3] Approval prompts in the main chat show only a multi-line command's first line until `ctrl+o`
[V3] The approval rule page highlights the scope choices, with the `s` hint beside them
Mermaid diagrams preserve node shapes, type colors, and logical group markers
`kiro-cli update` now suggests `brew upgrade --cask kiro-cli`, without `--greedy-auto-updates`
`--no-interactive` runs that stop on an agent now say `stopping (exit 4)` instead of claiming a fallback
[V3] `--no-interactive` runs stopped by a V2-format agent name `kiro-cli agent upgrade <dir>`
Clicks in fullscreen, including the scroll-to-bottom pill, no longer land one row above the target when a line above it wraps
[V3] The entire-tool row on the approval rule page names the tool, such as Shell, instead of one call
Mouse-wheel scrolling in `/fullscreen` works in AWS CloudShell and other terminals running older tmux versions
The Kiro logo ghost stays on the home screen while a command menu such as `/agent` or a panel such as `/memories` is open, when there is room for it
Mermaid flowcharts render nested containers instead of falling back to source
Mermaid diagrams fit long labels within narrow terminals
[V3] `/spec` prompts, review comments and `/spec view` summary rows no longer print escape sequences from specs
[V3] Approve for me: Kiro approves routine actions, blocks risky ones and asks when unsure; turn it on in `/permissions`
[V3] Shell approval rules offer a subcommand tier such as `git stash *` between the exact command and `git *`
`kiro-cli agent upgrade` warns when the upgraded rules deny, hide, or ask for something V2 allowed
[V3] Notice once per session for each agent whose V3 permission rules block what V2 allowed
`acp.agentEngine` setting to choose the engine for `kiro-cli acp`
Click the Kiro logo ghost in `/fullscreen` to play the next of five animations
[V3] Clearer questions with progress indicators during `/spec` requirements analysis
[V3] Shell tool cards title themselves with the model's description and show the Shell command below it when tool reasoning and tool args are shown; otherwise they render as before
[V3] Rule rows on the approval prompt keep the file name of a long path instead of cutting it short
Mermaid diagrams display titles and diagram-wide notes
Crash when an agent config lists unavailable MCP tools with non-ASCII names
Indented lines in a wrapped tool command no longer render as an empty row in narrow terminals
[V3] Update the bundled Node.js runtime to 22.23.4
Shell commands that set git config through env vars like `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` now ask for approval
Update the bundled Bun runtime to 1.4.4 for the Brotli decoder fix
